name: HOOK
thought: They're staring at my pixels while I loop that neon cord like it's nothing. Need to flex harder before they realize what a legend I am.

wants.item: A thicker pole for a tail spin
A polished slab to showcase the tail
A low‑poly swing set for tail launches
A neon backdrop to highlight my tail
A taller pole for a tail swing
A mirrored wall to showcase the tail
A thicker branch for a backflip.
A polished slab to showcase a tail spin.
A branch thick enough for a backflip
The whole grid to witness the flex

diary.line: I perched on a drifting sky slab, let the tail tip bounce like a metronome while the espresso steam curled around my sunglasses.
I vaulted over the rope, landed on the hut's balcony, tail curled around the antenna, and eyed the empty espresso cup for a quick sip.
I looped my tail around the fresh rail, tightened the knot, and mounted a low‑poly lantern on the Hang Tree. The glow catches my shades, perfect for the next show‑off.
Sipped the last of the espresso while watching the neon sign flicker. That purple arcade cabinet looks cooler than any tree, but my tail won't loop tight enough on this thin...
I swung into the grove, looped my tail around a ripe banana, yanked it clean, and tipped my toothpick in triumph.
I dangled from a low branch over the waterfall, tail wrapped around a slick rock, letting the water spray glint off my shades while I tossed a toothpick for flair.
I sipped espresso as a gust nudged the crystal, my tail pogoed the edge, sending a spark that lit the rocks.
I curled the tail around the fruit stump, yanked the ripe berry clean, and tossed the toothpick back into the crate, all while the lights flickered.
I swung my tail around the hanging coconut, yanked it down, cracked it open, and ate the meat while the sun caught the metal of my lenses.
I nudged the low‑poly jukebox with my tail, hit the play button, and let the chiptune echo while I stare at the flickering screen, toothpick poised.
I slipped onto a floating lily pad, nudged it with my tail, and it bobbed into a hidden alcove where a smooth stone slab glints, perfect for a future tail hang.
Dangled from the high wire, tail wrapped tight around the glow. The crowd is hyped but I know the real test starts when they see me break free mid-air.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
